title: VIP Central Park Pedicab Guided Tour

description.text: See the top landmarks of Central Park from the comfort of a pedicab with a licensed local guide. Cover more of the park in less time while stopping for photos at iconic locations including Bethesda Fountain, Bow Bridge, Strawberry Fields, and the Alice in Wonderland statue.

highlights: Explore Central Park by pedicab with a licensed guide
Stop for photos at Bethesda Fountain, Bow Bridge, and Strawberry Fields
Learn film, history, and architecture stories throughout the ride
Perfect for couples, families, and first-time New York visitors
additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

start.description: 10 Central Park S, New York, NY 10019, USA. Meet near the south side of Central Park close to major subway lines.
